title: VTA PCS — Member — Enrol Request — payload
description: A member's client asks its VTA for the blinded requests that enrol the member's events key for the current period's classes; the VTA keeps the blinding state. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

contextId.description: The context the engine belongs to; its key is derived from this context's base, for events alone (VTI-EVT-212).

memberDid.description: The member's identifier in the community, which signs the enrolment.

Response.title: VTA PCS — Member — Enrol Request — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a vta/pcs/member/enrol-request/0.1 request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vta/pcs/member/enrol-request/0.1#response.

document.description: The vtc/events/classes/enrol request, signed as the member, for the client to send unchanged.
